interface.longDescription: Talk normally with Corply to form a Delaware C corporation, run an existing U.S. startup, prepare a Mercury bank-account handoff, or build and inspect its customer-payment pipeline. Every MCP result carries canonical output and trusted next-step context while preserving human control over identity checks, provider terms, final submissions, go-live, refunds, and money movement. Corply is not a law firm.
